items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: he had George Treadwell was in the band and Dicky Harris and Jimmy Jones was playin' piano

ctx.x: What happened...you know after the show you had about an hour and a half break and so I went down to Cafe Society. I took a cab and went down there, because Sarah Vaughan was workin' there and J.C. Heard band was there and he had George Treadwell was in the band and Dicky Harris and Jimmy Jones was playin' piano and I loved him so and, of course, J.C. Heard and Al McKibbon. So I went down and J.C. asked me to play one because Budd Johnson had quit the band. And I played "How Deep is the Ocean" and they liked it…

there all the time. Canada Lee and all these people. It was just an international atmosphere. And it was beautiful. Leonard Feather was livin' upstairs and that's when I got, you know, to get to know him. And Mary Lou Williams used to come in and James P. Johnson was the intermission piano player. Then Josh White was the star sometimes.
